strings.currentTranslation: This film was obtained by Federation intelligence agents who infiltrated a drug syndicate on the planet Zajil. The photo showed a large number of kidneys growing thickly on one side of the dome-shaped cultivation garden. Kidun. It's a drug brought over from the Zorias Empire, and not only is it addictive, but users experience severe hallucinations. However, the biggest feature of this drug was that it was biojunk. Biojunk refers to genetic mutations within living organisms caused by the effects of special ingredients contained in Kidung, resulting in rapid evolution and degeneration both internally and externally. When this symptom appears, it usually results in a brutal death, but in some cases, there is a 1 in 10,000 chance that a ferocious bio-beast is born. As a result, mass killings have occurred in various parts of the Mars Federation over the past few months.
